summary: The filing reports entry into definitive reseller agreements and a strategic investment. Brand Engagement Network (BNAI) executed exclusive Mexico (via subsidiary) and global (ex-Mexico/Latin America) reseller pacts with Accelevate for 5-year terms; licensor receives 35% of gross revenue. Separately, BNAI will invest $1,000,000 in Accelevate at an $8M pre-money valuation, receiving full-coverage one-year warrants with stair-step strike prices ($10M or $12.5M valuation dependent on exercise timing) and board appointment rights. This is a material commercial and investment arrangement but not a classic special-situation classification.
